decisions.reason: A is highly related to the firm's automation and data capabilities and its data-driven strategy, so the firm can use its own R&D and research links to refine it rather than withdraw it.

B also fits the firm's software knowledge base, but its lower visibility and possible overlap with other archiving tools raise some portfolio-rationalisation risk even though absorptive capacity still favors retention.
D draws on existing water-engineering know-how, yet its more niche mechanical character and weaker fit with the firm's connected software-led direction make redeploying resources more attractive.
F is close to the firm's core automation and measurement competencies and to its future in connected infrastructure management, giving management strong ability to learn from projects and improve it.
